checks.expresion: ((((`yape` = 0) and (`plin` = 0)) or (`telefono` is not null)) and ((`transferencia` = 0) or (`numero_cuenta` is not null) or (`cci` is not null)))
(((`id_pago` is not null) + (`id_reembolso` is not null)) = 1)

(((`estado` not in (_utf8mb4\'CONFIRMADO\',_utf8mb4\'FINALIZADO\')) or (`confirmado_en` is not null)) and ((`estado` <> _utf8mb4\'FINALIZADO\') or ((`finalizado_en` is not null) and (`finalizado_en` >= `fin_evento_utc`))) and ((`estado` <> _utf8mb4\'CANCELADO\') or ((`cancelado_en` is not null) and (char_length(trim(coalesce(`motivo_cancelacion`,_utf8mb4\'\'))) >= 5))))

(((`id_solista_vinculado` is null) and (`estado_vinculo` = _utf8mb4\'SIN_VINCULO\')) or ((`id_solista_vinculado` is not null) and (`estado_vinculo` in (_utf8mb4\'INVITADO\',_utf8mb4\'ACEPTADO\',_utf8mb4\'RECHAZADO\',_utf8mb4\'RETIRADO\'))))
(((`id_pago` is not null) + (`id_reembolso` is not null)) = 1)
(((`id_retencion` is null) and (`vence_en` is null)) or ((`id_retencion` is not null) and (`vence_en` is not null)))
((((`id_reserva` is not null) + (`id_bloqueo` is not null)) + (`id_retencion` is not null)) = 1)

(((`cobrado_en` is null) or ((`verificado_en` is not null) and (`referencia_externa` is not null))) and ((`aplicado_en` is null) or (`cobrado_en` is not null)) and ((`estado` <> _utf8mb4\'APROBADO\') or (`aplicado_en` is not null)))
(((`id_servicio` is not null) + (`id_musico` is not null)) = 1)
((`estado` <> _ascii\'APROBADO\') or ((`confirmado_en` is not null) and (`referencia_externa` is not null)))
(((`privacidad_version` is null) and (`privacidad_aceptada_en` is null)) or ((`privacidad_version` is not null) and (`privacidad_aceptada_en` is not null)))

views.definicion: select `c`.`id` AS `id_contrato`,`c`.`total_centimos` AS `total_centimos`,coalesce(`a`.`abonado_centimos`,0) AS `abonado_centimos`,coalesce(`a`.`reembolsado_centimos`,0) AS `reembolsado_centimos`,((`c`.`total_centimos` - coalesce(`a`.`abonado_centimos`,0)) + coalesce(`a`.`reembolsado_centimos`,0)) AS `saldo_centimos` from (`santa_cecilia`.`contrato` `c` left join (select `p`.`id_contrato` AS `id_contrato`,sum(`p`.`importe_centimos`) AS `abonado_centimos`,sum(coalesce(`r`.`importe_centimos`,0)) AS `reembolsado_centimos` from (`santa_cecilia`.`pago` `p` left join (select `santa_cecilia`.`reembolso`.`id_pago` AS `id_pago`,sum(`santa_cecilia`.`reembolso`.`importe_centimos`) AS `importe_centimos` from `santa_cecilia`.`reembolso` where (`santa_cecilia`.`reembolso`.`estado` = 'APROBADO') group by `santa_cecilia`.`reembolso`.`id_pago`) `r` on((`r`.`id_pago` = `p`.`id`))) where (`p`.`aplicado_en` is not null) group by `p`.`id_contrato`) `a` on((`a`.`id_contrato` = `c`.`id`)))
